services.name: Lead service line replacement
services.blurb: The old lead pipe from the curb replaced with copper, and the meter connection redone.

services.name: Galvanized repiping
services.blurb: Gray galvanized supply lines swapped for copper or PEX, floor by floor, walls patched.

services.name: Sewer camera inspection
services.blurb: A camera run through the lateral, with every joint, root and sag logged by the foot.

services.name: Sewer lateral repair
services.blurb: Cracked clay laterals under steep yards repaired at the break or replaced end to end.

services.name: Dye test preparation
services.blurb: Downspouts and drains checked before the sewer dye test many local home sales require.

services.name: Pressure testing and regulators
services.blurb: Static pressure read and written down, then regulated when it runs above 80 psi.

services.name: Drain clearing
services.blurb: Slow and backed-up drains cleared, then the line filmed so you know why it clogged.

services.name: Water heater replacement
services.blurb: Tank heaters replaced with the age, size and venting of the old one noted first.

services.name: Backwater valves
services.blurb: A valve on the basement drain so a heavy storm cannot push sewer water back in.

reviews.text: The magnet test from their website told me my service line was probably lead. Dom confirmed it with a scratch at the meter, wrote it down, and walked me through the city program before quoting anything.
reviews.name: Erin T.

reviews.text: Ledger sheet after the camera run listed every joint: 12 ft cleanout, 31 ft offset joint, 47 ft roots. The repair was only at 47 feet instead of the whole yard we were dreading.
reviews.name: Paul S.

reviews.text: We were selling and the dye test was a week out. They found one downspout tied into the sewer, rerouted it to a splash block, and we passed on the first try.
reviews.name: Nadia B.

reviews.text: Upstairs shower was a trickle. Pressure at the basement was fine, so they traced it to old galvanized risers. Repiped the two floors over three days and patched the plaster cleanly.
reviews.name: Kevin O.

reviews.text: Basement drain backed up in the August storm. They put in a backwater valve and showed me how to check the flap. The next big rain the basement stayed dry.
reviews.name: Rosa F.

reviews.text: Paid a bit more than the first quote I got, but this one included the permit and the restoration of the sidewalk cut. The written estimate matched the bill line for line.
reviews.name: Stan W.
